title: Use a single product photo as input, generate a campaign still with GPT Image…
content: Use a single product photo as input, generate a campaign still with GPT Image 2, then feed that image into Seedance 2.0 to turn it into a cinematic ad spot.
tips: Use a single product photo as input, generate a campaign still with GPT Image 2, then feed that image into Seedance 2.0 to turn it into a cinematic ad spot.

es.content: Usa una sola foto de producto como entrada, genera una imagen de campaña con GPT Image 2, luego introduce esa imagen en Seedance 2.0 para convertirla en un anuncio cinematográfico.

fr.content: Utilisez une seule photo de produit comme entrée, générez une image de campagne avec GPT Image 2, puis intégrez cette image dans Seedance 2.0 pour la transformer en une publicité cinématographique.

ko.content: 단일 제품 사진을 입력으로 사용하여 GPT Image 2로 캠페인 스틸을 생성한 후, 그 이미지를 Seedance 2.0에 입력하여 시네마틱 광고 스팟으로 변환합니다.
